'''FG-53-5''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[TIE pilot]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], FG-53-5 was part of a TIE [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] unit that guarded a statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] installed in front of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] celebrations.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
FG-53-5 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He made appearances during the Empire Day live events of [[2009]].

==Appearances==
*{{GalaxiesAED}} {{1st}} {{C|Empire Day 2009-2011}}
